entities.name: Santa Maria delle Vigne
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Santa Maria delle Vigne is a Catholic basilica in Genoa, Italy. It was built in the 10th century. The church is the final resting place of the leading early Italian composer Alessandro Stradella, who was murdered in 1682.
